title: biatec_transaction authorization detail
description: RFC 9396 authorization_details object describing one signing call. Every field is decoded by Biatec OIDC from the unsigned group itself; client-supplied amounts or payees are never accepted. Protocol 1.1 (the only shape implementations produce) describes every outgoing transfer and every application of the group; the single-transfer shape of 1.0 is accepted so that 1.0 receipts keep validating.

transfers.description: Everything the sender sends out, one entry per payment or asset transfer, in group order. Transfers of other senders in the group are not listed.

applications.description: Every application the group calls. `trusted` is true only when the user trusted this application for this client on their own phone; there is no operator list.

value_known.description: False when any part of the value could not be priced or an application is not trusted: the card then says "Value unknown".

fiat_value.description: The group total. Present exactly when value_known is true.

origin.description: The site the request came from, as the client reported it. Part of the signed object, so a receipt proves which site asked.

receiver.description: Payee address. Absent when the group is an application call without a single payee.

application_id.description: Application called, when the group is an app call.

groupHash.description: Algorand: the base32 group ID (grp) recomputed by Biatec OIDC from the handed transactions, 52 characters; for one ungrouped transaction its transaction id. Bitcoin: lowercase hex SHA-256 intent hash derived from the PSBT with prevout data.

origin.description: An absolute origin: scheme, host and optional port, nothing else.

decimalString.description: Non-negative decimal as a string; never a JSON number, so no precision is lost under RFC 8785.

id.description: Algorand asset ID as decimal string, '0' for the native token, or 'BTC'.
